question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Gullibly
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gullibly"** means easily deceived or tricked; showing a readiness to believe things without skepticism. (आसानी से धोखा खाने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** She was **gullibly** convinced by the scam artist to give away her savings.
 
 
 
• **"Naïve"** refers to a person who is innocent and lacks experience or sophistication, often leading to a readiness to believe others too easily. (भोला)
 
 
• **Example:** The **naïve** young boy believed everything he was told without question.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Immunity** (प्रतिरक्षा): The ability of an organism to resist a particular infection or toxin.

 
 
• **Example:** Vaccinations help in building immunity against various diseases.
 
 
 
• **Fraternity** (भाईचारा): A group of people sharing a common profession or interests.
 
 
• **Example:** The medical fraternity gathered to discuss the latest advancements in healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Critical** (समीक्षात्मक): Expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments.
 
 
• **Example:** The professor was critical of the student's poorly written essay.
